entries.reason: The reference bundle registers a 2-argument Coalesce macro while desktop has no such macro: CQL Coalesce is a variadic Python UDF (CQL-08 removed the arity cap). This is the one place the browser has a macro desktop lacks. Removes when a native variadic Coalesce ships in the C++ extension and the TS macro is deleted.
entries.approved_by: Joel Montavon, 2026-11-24: build the test infrastructure first; not a fix-everything pass

entries.reason: The TS bodies are the pre-CQL-01/10/11 forms. Desktop adds Integer typing (Ceiling/Floor/Truncate return Integer), DECIMAL(38,8) results for Exp/Ln/Log, exact truncated division for Div and overflow-to-NULL guards. Root fix: generate the reference bundle from the desktop catalog instead of hand transcription (FEATURE_WASM_PARITY_TEST_INFRA.md section 7.1).

Desktop routes Boolean operators through __cql_bool_strict* so a non-Boolean operand yields NULL instead of SQL truthiness (CQL-04); the TS bodies are plain SQL AND/OR/NOT. Root fix: generate the reference bundle from the desktop catalog.

Desktop adds typed operand guards (Concat/Combine), the cqlregex* UDFs with CQL substitution rules (Matches/ReplaceMatches/SplitOnMatches) and the CQL-12 boundary rules for Substring. Root fix: generate the reference bundle from the desktop catalog.

Desktop adds typed-source guards, exact-Decimal statistics, CQL equality semantics for Distinct/IndexOf/Mode (CQLListDistinctEq, CQLListElementEqual, CQLListMode) and the empty/null rules. Root fix: generate the reference bundle from the desktop catalog.

Desktop rounds half away from zero for negative values and treats a null precision as 0 (CQL-11); Skip returns the list for a null count and [] for a negative count (CQL-19); Length of a NULL list is 0. The TS bodies use floor(x + 0.5) and return NULL in those cases. Root fix: generate the reference bundle from the desktop catalog.

Desktop preserves uncertainty for absent-vs-null display/version elements (CQL-02) and compares tuple elements with CQLTupleValueEqual (CQL-09); the TS bodies compare code and system only. Root fix: generate the reference bundle from the desktop catalog.

Desktop truncates Now() to milliseconds, prefixes TimeOfDay with 'T', trims Decimal trailing zeros in ToString and renders calendar duration units bare in QuantityToString (CQL-06/07/14). Root fix: generate the reference bundle from the desktop catalog.

The uncertainty-preserving list/clinical equality family (CQL-09, CQL-18) exists only as desktop SQL macros and was never ported to the browser. 118 of the 2,037 official CQL tests cannot run on the browser contract (CqlListOperatorsTest 268 -> 156). Port the macros (or their C++ equivalents) to the reference bundle.

Helper macros of the desktop strict-Boolean bodies for And/Or/Not/Implies. The current TS bodies do not need them; they must be ported together with those bodies when the bundle is regenerated from the desktop catalog.
CQL 2.0 list slicing (Slice and the Head/Tail helpers) has no browser counterpart; 10 official Slice tests fail on the browser contract. Port with the list-equality family.
Full-string regex match (CQL Matches anchoring) is a Python UDF on desktop only; 3 official Matches tests fail on the browser contract. Provide a C++ mirror or a TS body over regexp_full_match.
ValueSet expansion needs the loaded valueset terminology table; no browser dataset tier provides it yet.
Translator variable plumbing used only by desktop parameter paths; no translated test or measure SQL on the browser contract emits it today.

Both app bundles predate the reference: they still register CAST-based ToDate/ToDateTime/ToTime macros (the ToDate DATE-vs-VARCHAR drift already fixed in the cleanroom) and lack statements added since. Fix: import the reference module from both apps and re-run their Playwright suites.

Desktop wraps a Python UDF in a same-name macro; the browser contract runs the native C++ namesake. Both match the official expectation, but the declared type differs: desktop DECIMAL(2,0) vs native INTEGER (predecessor/successor) and typed UNION vs VARCHAR (High/LowBoundary). Values agree.

Desktop interval UDFs are Python and serialise interval JSON with spaces, unquoted numbers and Time bounds without the 'T' prefix; the native C++ mirror emits compact JSON with quoted numbers and 'T' bounds. Both match the official expectation (the comparators parse the JSON).

Desktop evaluates High/LowBoundary through the Python UDF (a null precision means the default precision, CQL-10); the browser contract runs the C++ mirror, which returns NULL for a null precision. Fix: port the null-precision default into the native boundary helpers and rebuild the bundles.
Fail on BOTH surfaces against corpus f724ee4: desktop conformance defects, not parity gaps (the official runner reports 2031/2037). In flight with the fhir4ds test fixes (Joel, 2026-11-24).

The native fhirpath UDF disagrees with the Python core engine on these official R4 tests, and the core passes them, so the expectation is reachable. Both Tier A surfaces share the x86 bundle, so this is a desktop finding; the shipped wasm bundle is older and cannot do better. Families: boundary fill rules (HighBoundary/LowBoundary), exponent literals, `is` on FHIR primitives, extension predicates, iif with a non-Boolean criterion (documented row-resilience doctrine), polymorphic `as`, JSON-looking strings in the VARCHAR[] transport.
The document functions (%`, section, entries, resources) are implemented in neither the core engine nor the native UDF; both fail the official expectation.
The `is` semantic checks (newer spec) are implemented in neither the core engine nor the native UDF; both fail the official expectation.

BulkPublishDemo ships a distinct cql wasm binary (sha256 e047fa7e...) and a caret-range duckdb-wasm pin (^1.33.1-dev41.0) while the four other apps pin 1.33.1-dev64.0 exactly and share one bundle set. Removed when the scripted wasm rebuild installs one bundle set everywhere (decision D-3) and the pin is made exact.

The shipped wasm bundles (cql built 2026-10-24, fhirpath 2026-09-19) carry only the v1.5.5 ABI stamp; no commit or source hash was recorded, so their distance from HEAD cannot be stated. Removed when scripts/build_wasm_extensions.py rebuilds them and fills `source` in fhir4ds/wasm_extension_bundles.json.
